messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

The 5 mg tablet is white to off-white and contains no color additives.
The 7.5 mg and 10 mg tablets also contain FD&C Blue #1 Aluminum Lake.
The 12.5 mg, 15 mg, 20 mg, and 30 mg tablets also contain FD&C Yellow #6 Aluminum Lake.
Triplet: ["Adderall", "has tablet color additive", "FD&C Blue #1 Aluminum Lake"]

The relation 'has tablet color additive' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug's tablet contains the color additive specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'contains ingredient': The subject drug product contains the active ingredient specified by the object entity.
B. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
C. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
D. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
E. 'has brand name': The subject drug is marketed under the brand or trade name specified by the object entity.
